paper_title: First constraints on QCD axion dark matter using James Webb Space Telescope observations
notes: Paper (Pinetti, arXiv:2503.11753) presents first JWST constraints on QCD axion DM via decay-to-photon lines using MIRI (0.1-0.5 eV) and NIRSpec (0.5-4 eV) blank-sky observations. 95% CL limits on g_agamma shown in Fig. 2; no numerical table provided, so data_points are approximate values read from the figure description (axis range 1e-13 to 1e-9 GeV^-1, limits improving on prior bounds by up to two orders of magnitude, reaching the QCD band near ~1 eV). This is a Galactic-halo decay (indirect) search, not a haloscope: assumes NFW profile with rho_s=0.18 GeV/cm^3, rs=24 kpc, and that axions constitute all Milky Way DM; dm_density_assumed left null per convention for non-haloscope searches. Digitization of Fig. 2 recommended for precise values. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 11))
